label: judgment
explanation: Two mandatory eligibility conditions fail. First, the title 'Technical Enablement Specialist - Field Engineering Onboarding' is a GTM enablement and training role, not an AI Engineer, ML Engineer, or Data Engineer role as listed in Priya's target roles (profile.target_role.primary, profile.target_role.secondary). Second, the description explicitly requires '5+ years of experience in a GTM role,' which exceeds the 3-year experience cap from CONTRACT.md D4§2. Priya's Databricks skill (skills.data_bi) aligns with the description's platform references but cannot override these disqualifying conditions.
